name: SAIC Motor
sub: China's densest OEM bridge into Momenta autonomy
all: AV Driver / Autonomy Software through Momenta
about: Large Chinese automaker with Momenta-linked ADAS and robotaxi relationships through SAIC, IM, SAIC-GM, and SAIC-VW channels.
model: Vehicle manufacturing, joint ventures, software-enabled vehicles, robotaxi pilots.
deployment: Robotaxi services in Shanghai, Suzhou and Shenzhen under the Xiangdao brand, driven by Momenta's software rather than SAIC's own; Momenta systems also appear across SAIC-linked passenger brands.
metrics: Momenta's July 2026 IPO materials highlighted SAIC as a major vehicle/customer ecosystem partner.
signal: SAIC is one of the densest OEM-to-autonomy bridges in China because they span domestic and JV brands.
